reviews.focus: exact current main and CI freeze
reviews.finding: Current main 347a4ff4... and CI run 1837 were verified before rebasing the audit.

reviews.focus: central ownership and preservation of Reviews 695-714
reviews.finding: The newer main timeline-integrity corrections were preserved; File 25 remains presentation owner only.
File 07 had advanced to runtime 1.2.1, DB 1.1.1, contract 1.2.1 and projection schema 3 at 2f4a8970..., while File 25 evidence remained older.
reviews.correction: Refreshed current source/staging evidence without promoting repository truth to deployment truth.

reviews.finding: The coded interface omitted normalization, canonical URL, visibility, actions, metrics, correction-state and sync methods required by the File 25 plan.
The File 21 adapter implemented only the historical subset.
reviews.correction: Implemented the full read-only provider contract; no foreign writes and no invented metrics.

reviews.finding: The compatibility provider also lacked the complete contract.
reviews.correction: Implemented the full compatibility contract while preserving File 21 canonical publication ownership.

reviews.finding: Provider registration did not call the plan-required sync hook.
reviews.correction: Registry invokes register_sync_events and fails closed on exceptions.

reviews.finding: Normalized items were not cross-checked against provider canonical URL, visibility, action and correction projections.
reviews.correction: Added fail-closed owner-projection parity before an item enters the merged timeline.

reviews.finding: Plan-required Most Viewed was absent.
reviews.correction: Implemented it only from provider-declared privacy-safe public view counts.

reviews.finding: Plan-required Most Saved was absent.
reviews.correction: Implemented it only from provider-declared privacy-safe public save counts.

reviews.finding: There was no explicit metric-sort privacy gate.
reviews.correction: Counts require privacy_safe=true, remain internal ordering inputs, and unavailable metric sorts are hidden/fall back to Latest.

reviews.finding: Review-state secondary refinement was missing.
reviews.correction: Added strict review-state validation/filtering across service, renderer, HTML and REST.

reviews.finding: Source-state secondary refinement was missing.
reviews.correction: Added strict verified/unverified source-state refinement without creating a new verification authority.

reviews.finding: The public timeline UI could not expose these refinements or conditional metric sorts.
reviews.correction: Added controls and URL-state preservation; unavailable metrics remain absent.

reviews.finding: Timeline REST lacked the new governed refinements/sorts.
reviews.correction: Added strict args plus applied-sort and available-metric-sort output.

reviews.finding: New review/source refinements were not included in explicit filtered-query noindex detection.
reviews.correction: Added both to filtered-query state so canonical profile SEO remains separate.

reviews.finding: Timeline pagination had page navigation but no explicit Load More control required by the plan.
reviews.correction: Added accessible Load More with numbered/next-page fallback; no infinite-scroll-only behavior.

reviews.finding: The new provider-contract work preserves the current-main bounded retrieval, multi-provider pagination, overflow safety, audited pin windows and truthful truncation warnings.
Files 03/07/08/09/14/17/19/20/21/22/23/24/26 retain their native authorities; File 25 remains presentation-only.
No further File 25-owned source omission was identified after corrections; external acceptance remains unclaimed.
